extracted_concepts.name: 正数和负数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers greater than zero and less than zero used to represent opposite quantities.

extracted_concepts.name: 有理数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers that can be expressed as a fraction p/q where p and q are integers and q is not zero.

extracted_concepts.name: 数轴
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A straight line with a chosen origin, direction, and unit length to represent numbers geometrically.

extracted_concepts.name: 相反数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Two numbers that differ only by sign; their sum is zero.

extracted_concepts.name: 绝对值
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The non-negative value of a number without regard to its sign, representing its distance from zero.

extracted_concepts.name: 有理数的加减法
aliases: Addition and Subtraction of Rational Numbers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Operations combining rational numbers using addition and subtraction rules based on signs.

extracted_concepts.name: 有理数的乘除法
aliases: Multiplication and Division of Rational Numbers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Operations combining rational numbers using multiplication and division rules based on signs.

extracted_concepts.name: 有理数的乘方
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Repeated multiplication of a rational number by itself, denoted as base raised to an exponent.

extracted_concepts.name: 整式
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Algebraic expressions consisting of variables and coefficients combined using addition, subtraction, and multiplication.

extracted_concepts.name: 整式的加减
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Combining like terms in polynomial expressions through addition and subtraction.

extracted_concepts.name: 一元一次方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An equation containing one variable with degree one, typically in the form ax + b = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: 从算式到方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Transitioning from arithmetic calculations to algebraic equations to solve problems.

extracted_concepts.name: 解一元一次方程
aliases: Solving Linear Equations in One Variable
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of finding the value of the unknown variable using inverse operations and properties of equality.

extracted_concepts.name: 实际问题与一元一次方程
aliases: Practical Problems with Linear Equations in One Variable
实际问题与一元一次方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Applying linear equations in one variable to model and solve real-world scenarios.

extracted_concepts.name: 几何图形
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Shapes and forms defined by points, lines, and surfaces in space or plane.

extracted_concepts.name: 直线
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A straight one-dimensional figure having no thickness and extending infinitely in both directions.

extracted_concepts.name: 射线
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A part of a line that starts at one endpoint and extends infinitely in one direction.

extracted_concepts.name: 线段
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A part of a line bounded by two distinct endpoints, containing every point on the line between them.

extracted_concepts.name: 角
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The figure formed by two rays sharing a common endpoint, measuring rotation between them.

extracted_concepts.name: 相交线
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Lines that cross each other at exactly one point.

extracted_concepts.name: 平行线
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Lines in a plane that do not meet, maintaining constant distance apart.

extracted_concepts.name: 平移
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A geometric transformation moving every point of a figure by the same distance in a given direction.

extracted_concepts.name: 平方根
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that when multiplied by itself gives the original number.

extracted_concepts.name: 立方根
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that when multiplied by itself three times gives the original number.

extracted_concepts.name: 实数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The set of all rational and irrational numbers, corresponding to points on the number line.

extracted_concepts.name: 有序数对
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A pair of elements arranged in a specific order, typically used to denote coordinates.

extracted_concepts.name: 平面直角坐标系
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A two-dimensional coordinate system formed by two perpendicular number lines intersecting at the origin.

extracted_concepts.name: 二元一次方程组
aliases: Systems of Linear Equations in Two Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A set of two linear equations with two variables, solved simultaneously.

extracted_concepts.name: 消元法
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A technique for solving systems of equations by eliminating one variable to simplify the problem.

extracted_concepts.name: 实际问题与二元一次方程组
aliases: Practical Problems with Systems of Linear Equations in Two Variables
实际问题与二元一次方程组
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Applying systems of linear equations in two variables to model and solve real-world scenarios.
